2026-11-07 06:53:41.707090 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:

2026-11-07 06:53:41.707098 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-07 06:53:41.707101 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-07 06:53:41.707105 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-07 06:53:41.707109 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-11-07 06:53:41.707113 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-11-07 06:53:41.707122 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
2026-11-07 06:53:41.707125 | controller |   instance name specified.
